description.value:
Your hand is infused with void energies, causing it to drain the vitality of creatures you touch.

Activate—Draining Touch 2 (void)

Frequency once per day

Effect You empower your hand to drain the energy of a living creature within reach. The target attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Drained]{Drained 1} until the start of your next turn. For 1 minute, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the Hit Points the target lost due to the drained condition.

Failure The target becomes drained 1 for 1 minute. For 1 minute, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points the target lost due to the drained condition.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Drained]{Drained 2}.
